name: Koshmar v Sovjonke
source:
The Sovyonok camp welcomes you once again with a warm breeze and familiar silhouettes of cabins. But something has changed. The shadows have grown thicker, the silence is too loud, and in the darkness between the buildings, red eyes flare up.

These are not people.
These are not dreams.
These are Nightmare Monsters — creatures born from fears, forgotten promises, and distorted memories. They are watching. They are waiting. And they come out only when you are alone.

Every night, the camp changes. Familiar places turn into traps, familiar faces become masks, and reality cracks, letting something alien seep through. The monsters see your fear. Red eyes follow your every step. There is no escape — only surviving one more night.

Will you be able to uncover the truth before they reach you?
Or will you become part of the nightmare yourself?

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?l=english&id=840607356]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Sovyonok营地再次以温暖的微风和熟悉的小屋轮廓欢迎你。但有些事情已经改变了。阴影变得更浓重，寂静太吵闹，建筑物之间的黑暗中，红色的眼睛闪闪发光。

这些不是人。
这些都不是梦。
这些是噩梦怪物——从恐惧、遗忘的承诺和扭曲的记忆中诞生的生物。他们正在观看。他们在等待。只有当你独自一人时，它们才会出现。

每天晚上，营地都会发生变化。熟悉的地方变成了陷阱，熟悉的面孔变成了面具，现实出现裂痕，让一些陌生的东西渗透进来。怪物看到了你的恐惧。红色的眼睛追随着你的每一步。没有办法逃脱——只能再活一晚。

你能在他们到达你面前之前揭开真相吗？
或者你自己会成为噩梦的一部分吗？

[来自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?l=english&id=840607356]Steam[/url]]
